repair_policy: Same unchanged stage worker: retry current stage with original prompt, last code, runtime error and traceback. Earlier accepted stages are not rewritten.
reasoning: low; lowest supported enabled reasoning if low is unavailable
sampling: All models require temperature 0; unsupported configurations block rather than silently switching to non-reasoning.
retrieval: Identical description-embedding top3 seeds per Procedure for docs and KG. KG2 includes first-paragraph API and input-role descriptions, removes IS_VALID_INPUT_TO before expansion, and retains one-hop plus FEEDS-only definition expansion.
postprocess: Stage six runs in the retained solve process. Coder returns postprocess_fields; server stores NPZ and metadata without correcting DOF ordering.
criterion: Coordinate-matched relative L2 < 1e-5; hyperelastic < 2e-3. Temperature uses the established increment normalization. Not an independent equilibrium test.
feedback: Runtime and output-interface errors only; reference values and mismatch are never sent to the coder.
timing: Record full workflow time, successful API-response time, API-error time, admission waits and stage-six time separately; provider-internal waits cannot be subtracted.
usage: Provider-returned input/output/cached/reasoning tokens and reported cost; missing fields remain null. Reasoning is a subset of output tokens.
